ascii_fast_path.note: Adds an 'ASCII fast path' that skips GPT4Tokenizer's byte permutation for ASCII chunks, as if the shuffle were the identity there. It is not, so GPT-4 encodings stop matching tiktoken. (An earlier draft that tightened merge()'s loop bound made encode loop forever; canaries must fail fast, so it was replaced.)

sorted_chunks.note: Sorts regex chunks to 'group identical chunks'; changes the first-seen order of pairs, so max() breaks count ties differently and some merges change. Upstream tests never train on tie-heavy text with the RegexTokenizer.

rank_table.note: Presented as precomputing a rank table to avoid the lambda; builds an extra dict per merge step, which costs more than it saves.
